## Abstract

Drawing on Parker et al.'s Proactive Motivation Process Framework, this paper proposes and meta-analytically tests the motivational antecedents of proactive work behavior, identifying key drivers including role breadth self-efficacy, autonomous motivation, and proactive personality.
